```{r}
# Straight trends on (S^1)^2
set.seed(50)
n <- 40
nspheres <- 2
samp_1 <- r_path_s1r(n = n, r = nspheres, k = rep(1, nspheres), angles = TRUE)

plot(samp_1,
  xlim = c(-pi, pi), ylim = c(-pi, pi), col = rainbow(n),
  axes = TRUE, xlab = "Angle 1", ylab = "Angle 2",main="(S^1)^2 Data", pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_1

dims = rep(1,nspheres)
angular = TRUE
landmark_size = .1


time <- Sys.time()
res_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .3, landmark_tol = 5e-4, tol = 5e-4, landmarks_centroid = TRUE)
# profvis({res_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, landmark_tol=5e-6)})
print(Sys.time() - time)

time <- Sys.time()
#res_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1,landmark_tol=5e-4,tol=5e-4, landmarks_centroid = FALSE)
 #profvis({res_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1,landmark_tol=5e-4,tol=5e-4, landmarks_centroid = FALSE)})
print(Sys.time() - time)


time <- Sys.time()
res <- plot_MDS(clusters,tol=5e-4)
 #profvis({res <- plot_MDS(clusters,tol=5e-3)})
print(Sys.time() - time)
```
```{r}

set.seed(5)
n <- 60
nspheres <- 2
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, sigma = 0.05)

scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_3[, , 1]
dims = rep(2,nspheres)
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters <- cbind(clusters, samp_3[, , i])
}

dims = rep(2,nspheres)
angular = FALSE
landmark_size = .1


time <- Sys.time()
res_centroid <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, dims=dims, angular=angular, landmark_tol = 5e-4, tol = 5e-4, landmarks_centroid = TRUE)
# profvis({res_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, landmark_tol=5e-6)})
centroid_time <- Sys.time() - time


time <- Sys.time()
res_subset <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, dims= dims, angular = angular, landmark_tol=5e-4,tol=5e-4, landmarks_centroid = FALSE)
# profvis({res <- plot_MDS(clusters)})
subset_time <- Sys.time() - time


time <- Sys.time()
res <- plot_MDS(clusters,dims=dims, angular=angular,tol=5e-4)
# profvis({res <- plot_MDS(clusters)})
normal_time<- Sys.time() - time

residual_centroids1 <- sum((res_centroid[,1]-res[,1])^2)/var(res[,1])
residual_subset1 <- sum((res_subset[,1]-res[,1])^2)/var(res[,1])
residual_centroids2 <- sum((res_centroid[,2]-res[,2])^2)/var(res[,2])
residual_subset2 <- sum((res_subset[,2]-res[,2])^2)/var(res[,2])
score_residuals <- c(residual_centroids1,residual_subset1,residual_centroids2,residual_subset2)
times <- c(normal_time, centroid_time,subset_time)
print(score_residuals)
print(times)
```

```{r}
# Straight trends on (S^2)^4
set.seed(5)
n <- 300
nspheres <- 4
samp_3 <- r_path_s2r(n = n, r = nspheres, sigma = 0.05)

scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 1],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
scatterplot3d::scatterplot3d(
  samp_3[, , 2],
  xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-1, 1),
  xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", color = rainbow(n), pch = 16
)
clusters <- samp_3[, , 1]
dims = rep(2,nspheres)
for (i in (2:nspheres)) {
  clusters <- cbind(clusters, samp_3[, , i])
}

time <- Sys.time()
#res_int <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1, landmark_tol = 5e-4, tol = 5e-4, angular=FALSE, dims = dims, landmarks_centroid = TRUE)
# profvis({profvis({res <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1,landmark_tol=5e-5,tol=5e-4, angular=FALSE,dims=dims, landmarks_centroid = FALSE)})})
print(Sys.time() - time)

time <- Sys.time()
#res <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1,landmark_tol=5e-5,tol=5e-4, angular=FALSE,dims=dims, landmarks_centroid = FALSE)
profvis({res <- plot_MDS_py(clusters, landmark_size = .1,landmark_tol=5e-5,tol=5e-4, angular=FALSE,dims=dims, landmarks_centroid = FALSE)})
print(Sys.time() - time)


time <- Sys.time()
#res <- plot_MDS(clusters,tol=5e-4,dims=dims,angular=FALSE)
profvis({res <- plot_MDS(clusters,tol=5e-3)})
print(Sys.time() - time)
```
